mapper.insert: insert into merchant(merchant_name, contact_name, contact_phone, address, is_valid, notify_type,notify_phone) values (#{merchantName}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, 1, 2, #{notifyPhone})
mapper.select: select id, merchant_name, contact_name, contact_phone, address, is_valid, notify_type, notify_phone from merchant where contact_phone = #{contactPhone}
